**Observation Log:**

[FACT] The North American Telugu Society (NATS) is a non-profit organization formed in 2009 by 200 volunteers.

[FACT] NATS aims to serve Telugu communities across North America.

[FACT] NATS conducts various cultural, spiritual, social, and educational activities.

[FACT] NATS has a 24x7 helpline (1-888-483-5848) to provide immediate assistance.

[FACT] NATS holds a bi-annual 3-day convention attended by approximately 8000 people.

[EVENT] The bi-annual convention includes cultural, literary, business symposiums, shark tanks, continuing education classes, women's forums, and career development for the younger generation.

[EVENT] Sambaralu is a cultural event held as part of NATS' bi-annual convention.

[EVENT] NATS organizes a Million Can Drive every year across the US to collect food items for local food banks and shelters.

[EVENT] NATS conducts classical dance and music programs, folk arts, and theater performances.

[EVENT] NATS conducts seminars, workshops, and training programs on various topics such as financial planning, career development, and health and wellness.

[EVENT] NATS is involved in various community service activities, including volunteering at local shelters, food banks, and schools.

[EVENT] NATS organizes sports events such as cricket tournaments, outdoor activities, and cultural games.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] President Obama's attendance at NATS would provide an opportunity to interact with the Telugu community and gain a deeper understanding of their cultural heritage and values.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] President Obama's presence at the event would be a great source of inspiration for the attendees.
